launchable_note: The lifecycle is launchable only once a validated attestation exists. The registered contract is what authorises the fresh sweep; this flag tracks whether the repository holds a completed certification package, and it stays false until reports/c26_current_engine_attestation.json is written against the immutable contract below.
purpose: The C26 contract and its archival calibration are registered together against the frozen 51-patch build source. The attestation is intentionally absent: it may only be produced from a completed fresh sweep, in a later commit, so no part of this registration can be read as evidence that the sweep happened.
